name: UK strikes & disruption
value: Consultants 25–27 Nov; Tube strikes from Nov
summary: Consultants in England strike 25–27 Nov; Tube drivers set strikes from late November into the Christmas period
state: The BMA said on 26 Oct that consultants in England will strike from 06:59 on 25 Nov to 06:59 on 27 Nov. Tube drivers have announced a series of 24-hour strikes running from late November through the Christmas period (ITV, 6 Nov). These are national or major strikes in single sectors, within the Watch band; no nationwide infrastructure failure was found as of 12 Nov.
for_you: Patients in England with planned care on 25–26 Nov may see appointments moved; NHS England advises using services as normal unless contacted. London commuters face Tube disruption on strike days; TfL and National Rail publish service updates.
rubric_hit: Watch: national strike in one sector (consultants in England, 25–27 Nov); not multiple simultaneous national strikes (Alert line)

sources.title: BMA — Consultants in England to take strike action in November

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.
drivers: Pay disputes, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, weather.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.
rubric.watch: National strike in one sector or major infrastructure disruption.
rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
